answer.reason: The core set is coarser than the vendor's five states. The adapter maps REFERRED to in_review and BOUND to bound, and QUOTED, DECLINED and LAPSED have no mapping of their own, so they presumably all fall into 'none'. The three-way split is exactly what HireService branches on (cover_in_review, no_cover), so it is the domain's own question of whether a hire has cover.
